bai: Bai 19 in an trong Excel: Print Preview, Page Setup, Margins, Fit to Page, Page Break

cong_thuc.cong_thuc: Ctrl+P hoac Quick Access > Print Preview
cong_thuc.giai_thich: Xem truoc in. Gan nut Print Preview len thanh cong cu nhanh de 1 click.
cong_thuc.vi_du: Click mui ten Quick Access > tich Print Preview; Ctrl+P mo preview

cong_thuc.cong_thuc: Print > Printer: chon may LAN hoac Microsoft Print to PDF
cong_thuc.giai_thich: Chon may in giay hoac in PDF de luu file.
cong_thuc.vi_du: Printer=Print to PDF > Print > dat ten Bai19.pdf > Save ra Desktop

cong_thuc.cong_thuc: Settings: Print Active Sheets | Entire Workbook | Selection
cong_thuc.giai_thich: Active Sheets: sheet dang lam; Entire Workbook: ca file (vd 36 trang); Selection: chi vung boi den.
cong_thuc.vi_du: Boi den tieu de+10 thu thuat > Print Selection chi in vung do

cong_thuc.cong_thuc: Pages: tu [1] den [10]; 1 trang cu the: 7 den 7
cong_thuc.giai_thich: Mac dinh in het; nhap from-to de in trang nhat dinh.
cong_thuc.vi_du: Entire Workbook 36 trang > Pages 1-10 chi in 10 trang dau

cong_thuc.giai_thich: Du lieu ngang nen chon Landscape cho dep va tiet kiem giay.
cong_thuc.vi_du: Bang rong chon Landscape; danh sach dai chon Portrait

cong_thuc.cong_thuc: Preview goc phai duoi > Show Margins > keo cham den
cong_thuc.giai_thich: Hien duong le de keo can truc quan.
cong_thuc.vi_du: Tich Show Margins > keo le tren xuong de tiet kiem trang

cong_thuc.cong_thuc: File > Options > Advanced > Display > Ruler units: Centimeter
cong_thuc.giai_thich: Mac dinh inch (8.5x14 inch); doi cm de can le theo chuan VN.
cong_thuc.vi_du: Doi xong Page Setup hien cm; Custom Margins nhap 2cm trai/phai

cong_thuc.cong_thuc: Page Setup > Margins: Top/Bottom/Left/Right + Center: Horizontally/Vertically
cong_thuc.giai_thich: Custom Margins nhap so; tich Center de bang nam giua giay doc + ngang.

cong_thuc.cong_thuc: Settings > No Scaling > Fit Sheet on One Page (hoac Page Setup > Fit to 1 page)
cong_thuc.giai_thich: Co toan bo ve 1 trang. Du lieu qua dai se rat be nen can nhan.
cong_thuc.vi_du: Ke hoach KD 4 trang > Fit Sheet on One Page con 1/1 trang

cong_thuc.ten: Page Break Preview keo ve 1 trang
cong_thuc.cong_thuc: View > Page Break Preview > keo duong xanh ve bien
cong_thuc.giai_thich: Xem vung ngat trang (Page1..4, duong xanh); keo duong xanh sat bien de gom 1 trang. Undo: Ctrl+Z.
cong_thuc.vi_du: 4 vung xanh > keo phai + keo xuong sat bien > Ctrl+P thay 1/1 trang

cong_thuc.cong_thuc: Page Setup > Header/Footer > Custom: Left/Center/Right + Insert Page Number (&Page)
cong_thuc.giai_thich: Vd Left='Ga Excel', Right=Insert Page Number; xem truoc thay header trai + so trang phai.
cong_thuc.vi_du: Custom Header Left: Ga Excel; Custom Footer Right: &Page (so trang tu tang)

cong_thuc.cong_thuc: Chon hang 17 > Page Layout > Breaks > Insert Page Break; View > Page Break Preview kiem tra
cong_thuc.giai_thich: Tach du lieu (trang 1) va bieu do (trang 2) thanh 2 trang rieng; keo duong xanh de dieu chinh.
cong_thuc.vi_du: Insert Page Break tai hang 17 -> Page1 du lieu, Page2 chart; Ctrl+P thay 1/2, 2/2

cong_thuc.cong_thuc: Page Layout > Print Titles > Rows to repeat at top: $1:$4 (hoac $4:$4)
cong_thuc.giai_thich: 29 trang van thay tieu de Doanh thu/Khu vuc/Vung/Tinh o moi trang; chon ca 1:4 neu co tieu de lon.
cong_thuc.vi_du: Rows $4:$4 lap hang tieu de; Ctrl+P trang 2 van thay tieu de

cong_thuc.cong_thuc: Boi den vung > Page Layout > Print Area > Set Print Area; Clear: Clear Print Area
cong_thuc.giai_thich: Chi in 10 thu thuat + tieu de; xoa vung in de tro lai binh thuong.
cong_thuc.vi_du: Set vung 10 thu thuat -> Ctrl+P chi thay vung do; Clear de bo

cong_thuc.ten: In Gridlines + tieu de dong cot
cong_thuc.cong_thuc: Page Layout > Sheet Options > Gridlines: tich Print; Row and column headings: tich Print
cong_thuc.giai_thich: Mac dinh preview khong thay luoi; tich Print de in ke o. Burst: View > Gridlines chi la hien thi.
cong_thuc.vi_du: Tich Gridlines Print -> ban in co ke o; bo tich thi trang tinh

cong_thuc.cong_thuc: File > Options > Advanced > Display options > bo tich Show page breaks
cong_thuc.giai_thich: Bo duong cham cham ngat trang kho chiu sau khi dung Page Break Preview.
cong_thuc.vi_du: Bo Show page breaks > OK; mo lai file khong con duong cham

thuat_toan_quy_trinh.ten: Gan nut Print Preview + chon may in/PDF
cac_buoc: Click mui ten Quick Access Toolbar > tich Print Preview
Click bieu tuong Preview (hoac Ctrl+P)
Printer: chon may LAN hoac Print to PDF
Neu PDF: Print > dat ten > Save

thuat_toan_quy_trinh.ten: In selection / sheet / workbook + so trang
cac_buoc: Boi den vung can in (neu in Selection)
Ctrl+P > Settings: chon Print Selection / Active Sheets / Entire Workbook
Neu nhieu trang: Pages nhap vd 1-10 hoac 7-7
Print

thuat_toan_quy_trinh.ten: Chinh huong giay + le + don vi cm
cac_buoc: Ctrl+P > Orientation: Portrait/Landscape
Tich Show Margins goc duoi > keo le truc quan
Neu can cm: File > Options > Advanced > Ruler units Centimeter > OK
Page Setup > Margins > Custom: nhap cm + Center Horizontally/Vertically
C1: Ctrl+P > No Scaling > Fit Sheet on One Page
C2: View > Page Break Preview > keo duong xanh sat bien phai + duoi
Ctrl+P kiem tra 1/1 trang
Luu y: du lieu dai se be, can nhan truoc khi dung

thuat_toan_quy_trinh.ten: Header/Footer + Tieu de lap + Vung in + Page Break
cac_buoc: Page Setup > Header/Footer > Custom Left 'Ga Excel', Right Insert Page Number
Page Layout > Print Titles > Rows $1:$4 de lap tieu de moi trang (file 29 trang)
Boi den vung > Page Layout > Print Area > Set; Clear khi xong
Chon hang 17 > Page Layout > Breaks > Insert Page Break de tach du lieu/chart; Page Break Preview keo chinh
Sheet Options > tich Gridlines Print neu muon in ke o; File > Options > Advanced bo Show page breaks de an duong cham

thuat_toan_quy_trinh.ten: Header/Footer + Tieu de lap + Vung in + Page Break
cac_buoc: Page Setup > Header/Footer > Custom Left 'Ga Excel', Right Insert Page Number
Page Layout > Print Titles > Rows $1:$4 de lap tieu de moi trang (file 29 trang)
Boi den vung > Page Layout > Print Area > Set; Clear khi xong
Chon hang 17 > Page Layout > Breaks > Insert Page Break de tach du lieu/chart; Page Break Preview keo chinh
Sheet Options > tich Gridlines Print neu muon in ke o; File > Options > Advanced bo Show page breaks de an duong cham
